question.text: Internet access inside the PM's dealing room:

answer.text: Restricted to activities related to trade execution

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 107 restricts internet access to activities related to trade execution. The Trap: Unrestricted access enables information leakage; a full ban is not what the source prescribes; personal hotspots bypass controls. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A page 107.
